warnings: Strict mode applies explicit hard constraints and may exclude scientifically interesting candidates.
explanation: Research Objective Exploration combines existing objective chains, scientific transitions, shared-element continuity, preferred elements, avoid-element warnings, and exploration mode into a ranked research view. Current mode: strict.

objective_coverage.avoid_policy_explanation: Strict mode excludes materials containing avoided elements during search, using recorded element membership; materials without membership records are also excluded. It then removes returned chains in which any material other than the source contains an avoided element, read from formula symbols. The source material is exempt.
limitations: Counts describe only the returned results, not the full dataset or all possible materials.
Element presence is read from reported formulas; it does not establish stability, synthesis feasibility or performance.
Ranked materials are not necessarily chain endpoints and may not appear in any returned chain.
Pathway counts exclude the source material.
Results were limited; coverage may differ for unreturned results.

Formula correspondence compares stored element ratios only. An exact alkali formula analog shows that two reduced formulas correspond under one alkali-metal change; it does not establish crystal structure or framework, oxidation states, synthesizability, stability, electrochemical behaviour, or that any reaction between the materials is possible.
Materials with distinct Materials Project IDs and the same reduced formula remain distinct materials.

Only pairs that the existing composition rules already place in the candidate pool are compared. Exact alkali formula analogs that share fewer than three elements with a material are not reachable and are not reported.
Formula groups and per-expansion admission counts are not yet reported.
